text:
ITEM 1 | Flaked mixture with pale beige-tan color and fine shredded texture, containing small pieces of white-pink flakes, finely diced green bits, and thin purple-white onion slivers, slightly moist with light sheen, mounded in a heap about 9 cm across and 2.5 cm tall at the upper right of the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Shredded orange carrot in thin matchstick strands, bright orange with slight sheen, loosely piled in a mound about 8 cm by 6 cm and 2 cm tall, lying beside the beans and olives | 90
ITEM 3 | Whole green beans, bright green with some darker spots, slightly glossy and tender-crisp, arranged in a diagonal cluster about 10 cm long and 6 cm wide along the right edge, some tips trimmed | 80
ITEM 4 | Cherry tomatoes, whole, glossy red with smooth skin, about 2.5 cm diameter each, roughly seven pieces grouped on the left side of the plate | 90
ITEM 5 | Dark brown to purple olives, whole, smooth wrinkled skin with slight sheen, about 2 cm each, roughly eight pieces clustered in a curved row below the carrots | 40
ITEM 6 | Piece of grey-green fish fillet with browned edges and flaky layered texture, about 6 cm by 4 cm and 1.5 cm thick, resting on the left side of the plate | 60
ITEM 7 | Off-white creamy sauce or dressing, thick and opaque with a glossy sheen, smeared in soft blobs about 5 cm across beside and under the fish fillet | 25
